---
title: "`r paste(params$sample_location, '- Pretreatment Comparison')`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 3
    code_folding: hide
params:
  sample_location: "Site"
  author: ""
  data_file: NULL
  min_replicates: 2
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)
library(ggtern)
library(soiltexture)

if (is.null(params$data_file) || !nzchar(params$data_file)) {
  stop("data_file parameter is required.")
}
if (!file.exists(params$data_file)) {
  stop(paste("File not found:", params$data_file))
}

min_replicates <- params$min_replicates

# Lightens a hex colour by blending toward white
lighten_hex <- function(hex, amount = 0.45) {
  v <- col2rgb(hex) / 255
  v <- v + (1 - v) * amount
  rgb(v[1], v[2], v[3])
}


# ── Read instrument file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dat <- readr::read_delim(
  file           = params$data_file,
  delim          = "\t",
  locale         = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-16LE"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    dplyr::where(is.character),
    ~ gsub("\\?m", "um", .x)
  )) |>
  janitor::clean_names(replace = c("µ" = "u", "μ" = "u")) |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_name, "^Average of\\s*'")) |>
  mutate(
    sample_name = sample_name |>
      str_remove("^Average of\\s*'") |>
      str_remove("'\\s*$")
  )

# ── Split bin columns from summary stats ─────────────────────────────────────
is_bin_col <- str_detect(names(dat), "^x\\d")

psd_long <- dat[, c("sample_name", names(dat)[is_bin_col]), drop = FALSE] |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = matches("^x\\d"),
    names_to  = "grain_um",
    values_to = "perc_vol_in"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    grain_um = as.numeric(
      str_replace_all(str_remove(grain_um, "^x"), "_", "."))
  )

summ_long <- dat |>
  select(-matches("^x\\d")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = where(is.numeric),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value_raw"
  )

# ── Parse sample names ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
parse_sample_name <- function(nm) {
  tibble(sample_name = nm) |>
    mutate(
      note      = str_extract(sample_name, "(?<=_\\d{1,3}_)[^_].+$"),
      rep_num   = str_extract(sample_name, "\\d+(?=(_[^_]+)?$)"),
      meta_code = str_extract(sample_name,
                               paste0("(?<=_)[A-Z](?=_", rep_num, ")")),
      sample_id = str_remove(
        sample_name,
        paste0("_", replace_na(meta_code, ""),
               if_else(!is.na(meta_code), "_", ""),
               rep_num,
               if_else(!is.na(note), paste0("_", note), ""),
               "$")
      ),
      depth_val = as.numeric(str_extract(sample_id, "[\\d.]+$"))
    )
}

sample_info <- psd_long |>
  distinct(sample_name) |>
  bind_cols(
    parse_sample_name(
      psd_long |> distinct(sample_name) |> pull(sample_name)
    ) |> select(-sample_name)
  )

# ── Replicate groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
replicate_groups <- sample_info |>
  group_by(sample_id, depth_val, meta_code) |>
  summarise(
    n_replicates = n(),
    sample_names = list(sample_name),
    notes        = list(unique(na.omit(note))),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_replicates >= min_replicates) |>
  arrange(meta_code, depth_val)

# ── Attach parsed fields to psd_long and summ_long ───────────────────────────
psd_long <- psd_long |>
  left_join(
    sample_info |> select(sample_name, sample_id, depth_val, meta_code, rep_num, note),
    by = "sample_name"
  )

summ_long <- summ_long |>
  left_join(
    sample_info |> select(sample_name, sample_id, depth_val, meta_code, note),
    by = "sample_name"
  )

# ── Pretreatment code descriptions ───────────────────────────────────────────
pretreatment_descriptions <- c(
  "A" = "No Pretreatment",
  "B" = "H2O2",
  "C" = "H2O2 then Acetic",
  "D" = "H2O2 then HCl",
  "E" = "Acetic",
  "F" = "Acetic then H2O2",
  "G" = "HCl",
  "I" = "Acetic then Furnace then CBD",
  "J" = "HCl then Furnace then CBD"
)

# ── Assign consistent base colours to each meta_code ─────────────────────────
meta_codes <- sort(unique(replicate_groups$meta_code))
palette    <- c("#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#59A14F", "#E15759",
                "#76B7B2", "#EDC948", "#B07AA1", "#FF9DA7")
pretreatment_colours <- setNames(palette[seq_along(meta_codes)],
                                 pretreatment_descriptions[meta_codes])

# ── Build comparison plot colour map (meta_code × note combinations) ──────────
comparison_colour_map <- psd_long |>
  filter(sample_id %in% replicate_groups$sample_id, meta_code %in% meta_codes) |>
  distinct(meta_code, note) |>
  mutate(
    display      = pretreatment_descriptions[meta_code],
    legend_label = if_else(!is.na(note),
                           paste0(display, " (", note, ")"),
                           display),
    line_colour  = if_else(!is.na(note),
                           map_chr(pretreatment_colours[display], lighten_hex),
                           pretreatment_colours[display])
  )

comparison_colour_values <- setNames(
  comparison_colour_map$line_colour,
  comparison_colour_map$legend_label
)

# ── Pre-compute CV% ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cv_all_raw <- summ_long |>
  filter(metric %in% c("dx_10", "dx_50", "dx_90")) |>
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value_raw)) |>
  inner_join(
    replicate_groups |> select(sample_id, meta_code),
    by = c("sample_id", "meta_code")
  ) |>
  group_by(sample_id, depth_val, meta_code, metric) |>
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_pct   = (sd_val / mean_val) * 100,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(metric,
      "dx_10" = "D10", "dx_50" = "D50", "dx_90" = "D90"),
    status = case_when(
      cv_pct < 3  ~ "Excellent",
      cv_pct < 5  ~ "Good",
      cv_pct < 10 ~ "Acceptable",
      TRUE        ~ "Poor"
    )
  )
```

---

# Overview

```{r overview, echo=FALSE}
cat(sprintf("File:                 %s\n", params$data_file))
cat(sprintf("Pretreatments found:  %d  (%s)\n",
            length(meta_codes), paste(meta_codes, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Sample groups:        %d  (minimum %d replicates each)\n\n",
            nrow(replicate_groups), min_replicates))

replicate_groups |>
  mutate(
    Notes      = map_chr(notes, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) "—" else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
    Replicates = map_chr(sample_names, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", "))
  ) |>
  mutate(Pretreatment = pretreatment_descriptions[meta_code]) |>
  select(
    `Sample ID`  = sample_id,
    Depth        = depth_val,
    Pretreatment,
    Notes,
    N            = n_replicates,
    Replicates
  ) |>
  kable()
```

# USDA Soil Texture Triangle

```{r texture-triangle, echo=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
replicate_texture <- psd_long |>
  filter(sample_id %in% replicate_groups$sample_id,
         meta_code %in% meta_codes) |>
  mutate(
    fraction = case_when(
      grain_um < 2                     ~ "clay",
      grain_um >= 2  & grain_um < 50   ~ "silt",
      grain_um >= 50 & grain_um < 2000 ~ "sand",
      TRUE                             ~ "gravel"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(sample_name, sample_id, depth_val, meta_code, fraction) |>
  summarise(perc = sum(perc_vol_in, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fraction, values_from = perc, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total     = clay + silt + sand,
    clay_norm = 100 * clay / total,
    silt_norm = 100 * silt / total,
    sand_norm = 100 * sand / total
  ) |>
  rename(SAND = sand_norm, CLAY = clay_norm, SILT = silt_norm) |>
  filter(total > 0) |>
  mutate(pretreatment = factor(pretreatment_descriptions[meta_code],
                               levels = pretreatment_descriptions[meta_codes]))

vertices      <- TT.vertices.tbl(class.sys = "USDA.TT")
classes       <- TT.classes.tbl(class.sys  = "USDA.TT")
usda_polygons <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(classes)), function(i) {
  pts <- as.integer(str_split(classes[i, "points"], ",\\s*")[[1]])
  vertices[match(pts, vertices$points), ] |>
    mutate(class = classes[i, "abbr"])
})

usda_labels <- tribble(
  ~class,    ~CLAY,  ~SILT,  ~SAND,
  "Clay",    0.700,  0.150,  0.150,
  "SiClay",  0.500,  0.450,  0.050,
  "SaClay",  0.450,  0.050,  0.500,
  "ClLoam",  0.320,  0.340,  0.340,
  "SiClLo",  0.330,  0.570,  0.100,
  "SaClLo",  0.260,  0.120,  0.620,
  "Loam",    0.180,  0.410,  0.410,
  "SiLoam",  0.120,  0.650,  0.230,
  "SaLoam",  0.080,  0.250,  0.670,
  "Silt",    0.060,  0.880,  0.060,
  "Lo Sand", 0.060,  0.080,  0.860,
  "Sand",    0.020,  0.050,  0.930
)

p_tern <- ggtern(data = replicate_texture,
                 aes(x = SAND, y = CLAY, z = SILT)) +
  geom_polygon(data      = usda_polygons,
               aes(x = SAND, y = CLAY, z = SILT, group = class),
               fill      = NA,
               colour    = "grey60",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text",
           x      = usda_labels$SAND,
           y      = usda_labels$CLAY,
           z      = usda_labels$SILT,
           label  = usda_labels$class,
           size   = 5,
           colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = pretreatment), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pretreatment_colours) +
  labs(
    title  = "USDA Soil Texture — By Pretreatment",
    T      = "Clay (%)",
    R      = "Silt (%)",
    L      = "Sand (%)",
    colour = "Pretreatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_clockwise() +
  theme_showarrows() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_tern)
```

# Pretreatment Comparison

*All replicates shown. Noted replicates appear as a lighter shade of their pretreatment colour.*

```{r comparison-plot, echo=FALSE}
comparison_data <- psd_long |>
  filter(sample_id %in% replicate_groups$sample_id,
         meta_code %in% meta_codes) |>
  mutate(
    legend_label = if_else(!is.na(note),
                           paste0(pretreatment_descriptions[meta_code], " (", note, ")"),
                           pretreatment_descriptions[meta_code])
  )

ggplot(comparison_data,
       aes(x = grain_um, y = perc_vol_in,
           group = sample_name, colour = legend_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colour_values) +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Grain Size Distributions —", params$sample_location),
    subtitle = "All replicates; lighter shade = noted variant",
    x        = "Grain size (µm)",
    y        = "Volume %",
    colour   = "Pretreatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Per-Pretreatment

*Each replicate shown individually. Noted replicates appear as a lighter shade.*

```{r per-pretreatment, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (mc in meta_codes) {

  groups_for_mc <- replicate_groups |> filter(meta_code == mc)
  base_colour   <- pretreatment_colours[[pretreatment_descriptions[[mc]]]]

  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", pretreatment_descriptions[[mc]]))

  rep_data <- psd_long |>
    filter(meta_code == mc,
           sample_id %in% groups_for_mc$sample_id) |>
    mutate(
      legend_label = if_else(!is.na(note),
                             paste0("Rep ", rep_num, " (", note, ")"),
                             paste0("Rep ", rep_num))
    )

  display <- pretreatment_descriptions[[mc]]

  # Build colour mapping for this pretreatment's replicates
  rep_colour_map <- rep_data |>
    distinct(legend_label, note) |>
    mutate(line_colour = if_else(!is.na(note), lighten_hex(base_colour), base_colour))
  rep_colour_values <- setNames(rep_colour_map$line_colour, rep_colour_map$legend_label)

  n_reps <- n_distinct(rep_data$sample_name)

  p <- ggplot(rep_data,
              aes(x = grain_um, y = perc_vol_in,
                  group = sample_name, colour = legend_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rep_colour_values) +
    labs(
      title    = display,
      subtitle = paste0(n_reps, " replicates"),
      x        = "Grain size (µm)",
      y        = "Volume %",
      colour   = "Replicate"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  cv_tbl <- cv_all_raw |> filter(meta_code == mc)

  cat("**D10 / D50 / D90 replicate CV%**\n\n")

  cv_tbl |>
    select(
      Percentile  = metric_label,
      `Mean (µm)` = mean_val,
      `SD (µm)`   = sd_val,
      `CV%`       = cv_pct,
      Status      = status
    ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) |>
    kable() |>
    print()

  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
}
```
